instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\dome_pocket.step. Create 3D Adaptive roughing and ball-end 3D finishing operations for the dome pocket. Roughing leaves 0.3 mm stock and finishing uses zero stock. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm flat end mill for 3D Adaptive roughing leaving 0.3 mm stock; T2 is a 6 mm ball end mill for finishing with zero stock. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-15.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
